description: This file defines a service class 'DateTimeHelperService' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Service'. It provides various utility functions for handling and formatting DateTime objects, such as formatting dates, converting seconds to time strings, comparing dates, calculating date differences, and determining week boundaries. The class also manages date formatter instances and includes constants for specific week-related calculations.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperService
classes.description: A service class providing utility methods for date and time operations, formatting, comparison, and boundary calculations.

methods.name: getDateFormatter
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocalizedDateFormatter for date formatting.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to 'Y-m-d' string format, or returns null if input is null.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object to time string ('H:i' or 'H:i:s'), or returns null if input is null.

methods.name: convertSecondsToTimeString
methods.description: Converts seconds into a time string in 'H:i' or 'H:i:s' format.

methods.name: isDatesEqual
methods.description: Checks whether two DateTime objects represent the same date (by Y-m-d), with optional null acceptance.

methods.name: dateDiffInHours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: dateRange
methods.description: Generates an array of DateTime objects spaced by the given interval between two dates; throws exception if fromDate is after toDate.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns current DateTime with optional timezone.

methods.name: getNowInUTC
methods.description: Returns current DateTime in UTC timezone.

methods.name: getTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeZone object based on a float offset, e.g., +05:30.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string based on configuration, or default format.

methods.name: getWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the week for a given DateTime, based on a specified starting day index.
